description: The object that owns the DI container, configuration, logging and hosted services, and controls startup and graceful shutdown.
The builder returned by `WebApplication.CreateBuilder`, where you register services and read configuration before calling `Build()`.
The cross-platform web server that runs inside the ASP.NET Core process, so no PHP-FPM-style worker pool is needed.
The value of `ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT` or `DOTNET_ENVIRONMENT` (default `Production`) that selects `appsettings.{Environment}.json` and environment-specific behavior.
One process serves many concurrent requests for its whole lifetime, so static fields and singletons are shared across requests and threads.
On SIGTERM or Ctrl+C the host triggers `ApplicationStopping`, lets in-flight requests finish and stops hosted services within `HostOptions.ShutdownTimeout` (30 seconds by default).
